notes.title: Patch V1.1.0
notes.notes:
We are happy to report that we fixed many issues in regards to:

-Minigames bug fixes
-Main game bugs
-Server bugs
-Optimizations (the game runs much faster now with way higher FPS)
-Game stability


We also added full controller support
The game is now playable with any joystick. 
Full Steam Deck support is added as well
